checkpoints.title: RPS-001 — Build and Verify a Round
Individual Review 4 — Improve and hand off
Group Review 4 — Improve and hand off
Studio 002 — Accounts and first saved game
Portfolio Review 4 — Improve and hand off

classes.label: Wed Nov 4 · Finish the posted RPS-001 task
classes.bring: Your RPS repository, SPEC, code, tests and actual results.
classes.work: Run the real round and full checks; inspect the diff and prepare the reviewed PR.
classes.review: Explain one test and the mistake it would catch. Try replay and keyboard controls.
classes.update: Keep the posted scope; link real issue, PR and CI results in SPEC.
classes.note: RPS-001 is due at 11:59 p.m., not before this class. Future targets are planned until Canvas posts them.

classes.label: Fri Nov 6 · Start the three products
classes.bring: Your current code, interests and one ambitious game idea.
classes.work: Introduce career research and portfolio design, the creative account/game journey and the customer-scenario menu.
classes.review: Compare two career/game directions. Choose a group customer and prepare discovery questions.
classes.update: Create three short records. Use any suitable stack and reuse earlier tests/pattern knowledge; Studios stay inside the game.
classes.note: These are planned future reviews. Confirm current teams and Canvas instructions before submitting.

classes.label: Wed Nov 11 · Plan workshop and peer questions
classes.bring: Three role cards, two portfolio directions, the game/account plan and a chosen group customer.
classes.work: Planned architecture/Docker introduction using the same app, then portfolio/design review and customer discovery. Compare local/container startup; exact lesson timing will be confirmed.
classes.review: Can a peer identify the audience, required game journey and customer problem without coaching?
classes.update: Keep career/design notes with the portfolio; game checks and labeled customer notes stay in their own records.
classes.note: Docker teaching is planned for next week. No new Docker deadline or grading rule is posted; keep the existing research/plan targets.

classes.label: Fri Nov 13 · Review 1 target; start a working slice
classes.bring: Portfolio research/design, game/account stories and the group’s agreed customer scope.
classes.work: Start the game account/result slice, the customer workflow and two small portfolio presentation options.
classes.review: Predict one successful task and one rejected action before testing.
classes.update: Link actual code/checks and current portfolio drafts; use the same three records.

classes.label: Wed Nov 18 · Build workshop and cross-review
classes.bring: Accounts plus a playable game slice, group workflow code and two portfolio presentations.
classes.work: Test a saved game and account boundaries; cross-review the group slice and try portfolio reader tasks.
classes.review: Observe a real classmate, open a useful issue and compare the design alternatives.
classes.update: Record actual checks, pattern/AI decisions and peer findings; reuse game evidence for Studio 002.

classes.label: Fri Nov 20 · Review 2 target; integrate the build
classes.bring: Current game/accounts, group slice and chosen portfolio presentation.
classes.work: Introduce dashboard and account maintenance. Request the customer simulator’s bounded change; plan integration and final reviews.
classes.review: Which account/data boundary or customer assumption needs a test or change?
classes.update: Reuse the game evidence for the Studio; update customer notes and portfolio case studies.
classes.note: Final-review expectations are explained now, before recess. No new topic starts in the protected finish week.

classes.label: Wed Nov 25 · Integration and review workshop
classes.bring: Integrated account/game, customer workflow and portfolio with current links.
classes.work: Check persistence, dashboard, account updates and ownership. Resolve the customer change and test portfolio navigation.
classes.review: Try each product’s agreed task without coaching; compare expected with actual behavior.
classes.update: Record defects, actual tests and response/retest plans. Freeze scope before finishing week.
classes.note: Friday conversion day: Section 001 meets Wednesday November 25 at its usual Friday time.

classes.label: Wed Dec 2 · Build snapshot; protected finishing work
classes.bring: Three Review 3 snapshots, game integration checks and unresolved issues.
classes.work: Capture the snapshots; repair account/data, customer workflow and portfolio issues. Complete missed peer reviews; no new topic.
classes.review: Observe the changed task and rerun the affected checks.
classes.update: Keep the same three records and URLs; finalize actual AI-learning and contribution notes.
classes.note: Planned build target after the holiday. This does not add a new report or restart the project.

classes.label: Fri Dec 4 · Protected reviews and rehearsal
classes.bring: All working projects, issue responses, final links and actual contribution notes.
classes.work: Finish repairs and real reviews for game, customer project and portfolio; rehearse the architecture, evidence and professional introduction.
classes.review: Have a peer try the changed task again; verify the result and remaining limits.
classes.update: Finalize the same record: actual checks, pattern choice and one next-time change. No new feature area.

classes.label: Sun Dec 6 · Planned final-ready target — no class
classes.bring: The chosen game, customer workflow and portfolio; existing records and final source revisions.
classes.work: No Sunday class is scheduled. This is the proposed final-ready cutoff.
classes.review: Include actual feedback/change/retest evidence; do not invent a missing check.
classes.update: Keep the same working links for the proposed class demos.
classes.note: Planned until posted in Canvas; 11:59 p.m. Eastern.

classes.label: Wed Dec 9 · Planned regular-class Demo Day
classes.bring: Your assigned time if announced, all three products, source/spec and evidence.
classes.work: Demonstrate if scheduled; give useful feedback on classmates’ work.
classes.review: Explain your contribution, one choice, a check and a meaningful improvement.
classes.update: Keep the same URLs and follow actual instructor feedback.
classes.note: Regular-class demo dates are planned; Canvas will confirm slots, duration and delivery details.

classes.label: Fri Dec 11 · Planned regular-class Demo Day
classes.bring: Your assigned time if announced, all three products, source/spec and evidence.
classes.work: Demonstrate if scheduled; give useful feedback on classmates’ work.
classes.review: Explain your contribution, one choice, a check and a meaningful improvement.
classes.update: Keep the same URLs and follow actual instructor feedback.
classes.note: Regular-class demo dates are planned; Canvas will confirm slots, duration and delivery details.

classes.label: Wed Dec 16 · Announced final / redo block
classes.bring: Confirmed presentation instructions and working project links.
classes.work: Remaining presentations and needed redos, 2:30–5 p.m. Eastern.
classes.review: Explain actual work and evidence; identify limits.
classes.update: Follow the instructor’s confirmed final arrangements.
classes.note: Both sections share the announced block. Canvas says Zoom; Registrar lists FMH 408. Delivery details must be confirmed.
